description: This file defines a class 'MonkeySourceNetworkVars' which manages system and application variables related to the Android environment and the Monkey testing tool. It provides mechanisms to list available variables and retrieve their current values, including build info, display metrics, current activity intent info, and clock timings.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetworkVars
classes.description: Class providing static methods and nested classes for listing and retrieving system and app variables in the Monkey testing environment.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetworkVars.ListVarCommand
classes.description: Implements command to list all available variable keys.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetworkVars.GetVarCommand
classes.description: Implements command to retrieve the value of a specific variable.

methods.name: translateCommand
methods.description: Executes the command (list or get) based on input arguments, returning the variable keys or their current values.
